basic_info.description: Extensively renovated and expanded, this 2 bedroom + den, 2 bathroom architectural gem offers breathtaking views of San Francisco and the San Bruno Mountains. Designed by the architecture and engineering team of Krolicki/Krolicki, this one-of-a-kind Glen Park home boasts an extensive list of refined finishes: Custom Douglas Fir kitchen cabinets, Waterworks and Ann Sacks tile, custom Bonelli double paned insulated windows, Velux skylights (x3), Hansgrohe/Toto/Duravit bathroom finishes, custom Cedar wood staircase wall, Hunter Douglas remote-controlled custom shades, custom steel handrails, Elfa shelving systems, and more. Detached on 3 sides and uniquely positioned apart from the neighbors, the home is bathed in natural light with windows on all sides, multiple skylights and an atrium with a living wall adjacent to the kitchen. The upper floor is a masterpiece, featuring a luxurious primary suite with wide city views, a private balcony, designer bathroom, and a walk in closet. The main floor is designed for comfort and entertainment, with a spacious media/family room featuring floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open directly to the expansive rear landscaped garden. The open kitchen, living and dining area offers partial southern views and ample space for hosting.
